response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior full-stack engineer with broad experience across web, mobile, and infrastructure, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role, particularly the 8 years of C++ programming (he has only brief, early-career C/C++ exposure at National Instruments and a bachelor thesis project) and the 5 years of large-scale distributed systems/compute/storage/hardware architecture experience. He also lacks explicit technical leadership or mentoring-of-cloud/DevOps-engineers experience at the depth this role requires.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse software engineering experience across multiple stacks and domains
Demonstrated craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) and mentoring via workshops/talks
Founder experience running an open-source platform, showing initiative and ownership
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months at National Instruments, some early student work) versus the required 8 years
No clear large-scale distributed systems, cloud compute platform, or hardware architecture experience matching the 5-year requirement
No evidence of formal technical leadership role managing/mentoring cloud or DevOps engineers

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud/distributed systems background
Strong general seniority and mentoring/craftsmanship exposure
